svg.title: Atlas system design: The AI editor designs an issue
svg.desc: Atlas architecture with the "The AI editor designs an issue" flow playing through it, 12 steps through 6 parts.

g.text: Drawn on a canvas in the browser; the originals never leave.
STEP 2 OF 12 · REQUEST · READER'S BROWSER → VERCEL
Up to 10 previews, the story, art direction id and note.
STEP 3 OF 12 · REQUEST · VERCEL → EXPRESS API
Its own 4 MB JSON parser runs before the 1 MB global one.
STEP 4 OF 12 · CHECK · EXPRESS API → SUPABASE AUTH
Sign-in is on for the editor in src/types.
Photo count, data-URL shape, size caps, theme and face lists, direction id. A bad request is refused before anything…
STEP 7 OF 12 · REQUEST · EXPRESS API → POSTGRES
Then the story is checked against the plan's word limit (413).
STEP 8 OF 12 · REQUEST · EXPRESS API → POSTGRES
One statement decides and increments, so a double-click can't slip two claims past it. Free 2, Traveller 5,…
STEP 9 OF 12 · REQUEST · EXPRESS API → ANTHROPIC
Opus 5.5, adaptive thinking at medium effort, a JSON schema for the plan, and a server-side fallback model if the…
STEP 10 OF 12 · REPLY · ANTHROPIC → EXPRESS API
Bounds every number, checks fonts against the list offered, and refuses an answer without a usable design.
STEP 12 OF 12 · REPLY · EXPRESS API → READER'S BROWSER
Create.tsx applies it with an undo.
THE AI EDITOR DESIGNS AN ISSUE · 12 STEPS THROUGH 6 PARTS
The only call that sends photographs: 512px previews and the story go to the model, a page-by-page plan comes back.
Every hop is read from the code: the dot is the request; faded parts take no part in this flow.
